commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
90+2' That's the end of the game for Evanilson, who is replaced by Julio Soler (Bournemouth).

90+1' Veljko Milosavljevic (Bournemouth) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The resulting corner from Yasin Ayari (Brighton) comes to nothing.
89' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
88' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
87' James Hill will be replaced by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth).
86' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) replaces Marcus Tavernier.
85' James Hill (Bournemouth) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
84' The corner from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen.
84' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Bournemouth will have an opportunity.
83' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) but poses no threat.
82' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
82' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
80' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
79' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Brighton earn a free kick.
75' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Bart Verbruggen to dive and make a save.
74' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) sees a yellow card from Peter Bankes after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
70' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes.
69' Stefanos Tzimas (Brighton) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process. Bournemouth will take a free kick.
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Amine Adli (Bournemouth) coming on for Alex Scott.
68' A substitution has been made. David Brooks goes off and Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) comes on.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. James Milner will be replaced by Carlos Baleba (Brighton).
67' Fabian Hurzeler decides to make a substitution. Georginio Rutter will be replaced by Stefanos Tzimas (Brighton).
67' Substitution. Danny Welbeck walks off the pitch and Brajan Gruda (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.

67' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
66' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
66' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
63' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to James Milner (Brighton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
61' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen no chance!
60' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is going to take the penalty!
59' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) jumps into a tackle and Peter Bankes signals a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. Bournemouth are awarded a penalty kick!
58' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Peter Bankes didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
57' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
56' David Brooks (Bournemouth) will deliver the corner kick.
56' David Brooks (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
55' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
55' The referee awards a corner and James Milner (Brighton) goes over to take it.
55' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

54' That's unlucky! Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Brighton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
53' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
51' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
48' 1 - 1 Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) latches onto a brilliant cross and produces a perfect header that goes inside the left post to give the goalkeeper no chance!
48' A superb shot by David Brooks (Bournemouth) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
47' Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul after Joel Veltman (Brighton) hacks down one of his opponents. Bournemouth have a free kick.
46' The whistle blows and Peter Bankes starts the second half.
45+5' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth). Peter Bankes saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brighton.
45+3' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Peter Bankes interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth). Brighton are awarded the free kick.
41' James Milner (Brighton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

41' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Djordje Petrovic is alert and denies him with a nice save. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
38' Great teamplay by Brighton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
36' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is booked.
36' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Peter Bankes blows for a foul. Brighton win a free kick.
35' David Brooks (Bournemouth) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
34' Bournemouth are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
31' David Brooks (Bournemouth) is booked by the referee.
30' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Peter Bankes ignores the protests.
30' Joel Veltman (Brighton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Bournemouth have been awarded a free kick.
30' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and signals a foul after Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) brought his opponent down. Brighton are awarded a free kick.

26' What an opportunity! Evanilson (Bournemouth) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
24' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) comes onto the pitch after Maxim De Cuyper signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
24' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Alex Scott (Bournemouth) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
17' The game is interrupted now, Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
14' A pass from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen and the move breaks down.
13' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Brighton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
11' Brighton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
7' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
3' Fabian Hurzeler is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jack Hinshelwood suffers an injury and Yasin Ayari (Brighton) comes on.
2' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Brighton will take the kick-off.
Peter Bankes is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
